title: Human civilization as a cargo cult from an ancient contact event

tellings.quote: concept. So our concept in starting this project was that our entire society is a cargo cult because everything we're trying to do

plain: All of human society may be a cargo cult, a group copying the visits of an advanced outsider it does not understand, left over from some ancient meeting with beings from elsewhere. The author Peter Levenda gives this as the starting idea behind Sekret Machines: Gods, a book project he worked on with the musician Tom DeLonge, saying "our entire society is a cargo cult because everything we're trying to do" goes back to that contact. If true, it would mean much of what humans build is an imitation of visitors.
